US Data Center Projects Spark Bipartisan Opposition Amid AI Concerns

A significant controversy is unfolding across the United States concerning the development of large-scale data centers, particularly those associated with Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies. In rural Pennsylvania, a $165 million data center project has become a focal point for local opposition, described by one outlet as a fight representative of a bipartisan battle against AI. This sentiment is echoed in Nevada, where a deal involving the Trump administration related to data centers has intensified a fight within the governor's race. Reports indicate that AI data centers, even those previously championed by figures like Donald Trump, are now generating anger among residents in the US.
